name: Government Organizations Officer Mock - Practice Test 1

questions.question: Which body acts as the supreme audit authority in India?
questions.hint: Article 148 mandates CAG to audit receipts and expenditures of government.

questions.question: In administrative terminology, what is a circular?
questions.hint: Circulars broadcast standard policies or notices to broad employee lists.

questions.question: The right to information (RTI) in India was enacted in:
questions.hint: RTI Act of 2005 replaced the older Freedom of Information Act.

questions.question: Who is the head of the civil services board in India?
questions.hint: Cabinet Secretary heads the Civil Services Board and civil administrations.

questions.question: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) was established on recommendations of:
questions.hint: Santhanam Committee recommended CVC in 1964 to combat corruption.

questions.question: What is the term of office for a member of UPSC?
questions.hint: UPSC members hold office for 6 years or until reaching 65 years of age.

questions.question: Official secrets act in India was first enacted in:
questions.hint: The OSA was passed in 1923 during British rule to secure official files.

questions.question: In government offices, CCS Rules stand for:
questions.hint: CCS (Conduct) Rules outline the code of conduct for central bureaucrats.

questions.question: The budget is presented in the Parliament by:
questions.hint: Ministry of Finance drafts the annual budget, presented by the minister.

questions.question: What does NITI in NITI Aayog stand for?
questions.hint: NITI stands for National Institution for Transforming India, replacing the Planning Commission.

questions.question: The supreme command of defence forces is vested in:
questions.hint: Article 53(2) gives supreme command of Defence Forces to the President.

questions.question: Who administers oath to the Governor of a state?
options: Chief Justice of the State High Court
questions.hint: Article 159 dictates that the Chief Justice of State High Court administers the oath.

questions.question: The national human rights commission (NHRC) is a:
questions.hint: NHRC was set up under Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993, making it statutory.

questions.question: Which schedules of Indian Constitution contain list of languages?
questions.hint: The 8th Schedule lists 22 officially recognized languages.

questions.question: What is the minimum age to become member of Rajya Sabha?
questions.hint: Article 84 requires a minimum age of 30 for Rajya Sabha, and 25 for Lok Sabha.
